question: Do the SEGI counts reproduce the review?
statistic: clone chr4 genet c_hat and z vs PANEL_ALL; PANEL_ALL size

question: Do all ramets and the genet carry 5 chr4 copies?
statistic: per ramet c_hat, z, rank; genet c_hat with bootstrap CI; prediction t vs ALL, LOCAL, SOUTH; f_lo
threshold: one-sided p < 0.001 vs all three panels; each ramet c_hat in [4.5, 5.5] and below every PANEL_ALL genet; genet CI excludes 5.5
if met: every sampled ramet lacks one of six chr4 copies; the genet c_hat is X (CI)
if not met: name the panel or ramet that fails; "deficit not confirmed for <ramet>"
does NOT license: mechanism, timing, phenotype; that tissues other than leaf share it

question: Does any other chromosome deviate?
statistic: prediction t per chromosome, chr4 out of every normaliser
threshold: Holm p < 0.05 (m = 10) and same sign with p < 0.05 vs LOCAL and abs(c_hat - 6) >= 0.5
if not met: no other chromosome deviates beyond the population range
does NOT license: inherited allelic composition (AD-het chr7 shared with WPR) is not a copy change

question: Does the positional scan call known whole-copy gains whole?
statistic: T on the gained chromosome vs that chromosome's panel null

question: Is the chr4 loss whole-chromosome?
statistic: segment scan T on the 9-ramet mean VCF-DP log2 profile (20-Mb SEGI bins), panel null T95/T99; f_lo from R1a
threshold: WHOLE: T < T95 and f_lo >= 0.80; PARTIAL: T >= T99 and segment >= 2 bins and abs(delta) >= 0.13 log2
if met: whole-chromosome (or near-whole) loss; no segment >= MDS deviates; >= f_lo of chr4 read mass at 5 copies
if not met: PARTIAL: report segment, then a synteny check before any text; else INCONCLUSIVE with MDS
does NOT license: which homeolog was lost; segments smaller than MDS

question: How unusual is the clone; what else is in the survey?
statistic: per sample x chromosome z (SEGI counts) vs PANEL_ALL; class whole-copy-like vs fractional; G3 mapping
scope / n: non-clone samples with > 1 M reads x 11
threshold: abs(z) >= Bonferroni bound for (n x 11) two-sided 0.05 (printed, about 4.3)
if met: list hits; "no other tree carries a whole-copy chr4 loss" if no chr4 hit with abs(c_hat - 5) <= 0.25

question: Is WPR aneuploid?
if not met: WPR euploid by depth; the 2024 sheet flag is not supported

question: Is the 14_364 deficit segmental or uniform-fractional?
statistic: segment scan T on chr4 and chr9 (single sample, sigma_total), panel null; het and sub-lattice share vs panel
threshold: SEGMENTAL: T >= T99 and segment c_hat within 0.5 of 5 (chr4) / 7 (chr9) and the rest within 0.5 of 6; UNIFORM: T < T95
if met: SEGMENTAL: "a partial chr4 loss / chr9 gain"; UNIFORM: "mosaic-like or mixed library" (mixture disfavoured if het <= P90 and sub-lattice <= P95)
does NOT license: mosaicism vs mixture without a second sample

question: Do allele fractions support the loss independently of depth?
statistic: prediction t of the clone chr4/other ratio for MAF (primary) and HET vs the depth-matched (5/6-thinned) panel
if met: allelic data independently support a copy loss
if not met: both in direction: "consistent, not independently significant"; either opposite with p < 0.05: "not supported"
does NOT license: k of the lost homeolog; a copy number

question: Are ramet-private alleles replicated across stems as well as across same-tree libraries?
statistic: kappa G000 vs comparator (8 same-tree genets); delta kappa; excess E; two-level bootstrap
threshold: lower 95% bound of delta > 0 and >= 50% of delta retained without pool 31 and in the top depth tertile
if met: a small stem-specific excess: E (CI) alleles per library at survey SNP sites
if not met: delta > 0 but < 50% without pool 31: "pool-31 libraries"; CI includes 0: "no excess; upper bound E_hi"
does NOT license: a mutation rate; founding-tree or ramet age

question: Are the nine stems one genet at replicate precision?
statistic: class distances from the parent's fig2 pairs; gap; chr4-excluded and depth sensitivities
scope / n: 36 within-clone pairs; replicate classes; WPR; C1; south
threshold: gate R5-g exact match; "one genet" if max within <= max(technical, same-tree) + 0.005 and < min clone-WPR

question: What do the October 2026 runs show?
statistic: per-tube tier, ratio (two windows), suppression, day x voltage strata

question: (template) Is the clone's 2C lower than euploid trees' in a designed run?
statistic: delta % within stratum, unit = chop, two-level bootstrap
threshold: per proposal 4c with the review's k-dependent power
if met: consistent with one-copy loss if CI excludes 0 and the point estimate is in [-2.3, -0.8]%
